features.title: Finance & Books hub, finance data catalog and reconciliation

source.description: Canonical sources: company_revenue_logs (all revenue streams), disbursements (paid payouts), and the BOOKS-01 ledger tables via get_ledger_books (recorded entries, closes, reopens). Source tables tips, subscriptions, sponsorships, shop_orders, custodial_withdrawals and filmer_rewards are read for reconciliation. Reads are paged with an exact row count; a failed page discards partial rows; a missing table or column is 'not read', never zero; a missing migration reads as 'not switched on'. Every money column is classified in the finance data catalog (coverage test against schema.sql and every migration).

actions: Record Stripe fees, expenses, payouts to bank, booster operator payments, owner money and whole-charge refunds as balanced entries
Void an entry by reversal with a reason
Close a finished month with its fingerprint, and reopen it with a reason kept in an audit table
Export QuickBooks daily/detail journals, general ledger, chart of accounts, tax pack and filtered transactions (blocked while any source is unread or the books do not balance)

metrics: Tapua'i income, expenses and net for the selected UTC month/quarter/year; money held for families, athletes and operators (opening, added, paid out, closing) with a per-athlete subledger; trial balance; tax-year pack with net per estimated-tax period; reconciliation of every source row to the revenue log (all time). Unread sources show 'Not read', never zero; every table has a complete Data alternative; athlete names on screen only, pseudonymous references in exports. Revenue remains the operational revenue report; this hub is the accounting view and links back to it.

disable.strategy: No runtime flag: the hub is admin-only and writes nothing until the bookkeeping migration is applied. Repair is by reversal (void) or reopen with a reason; nothing is edited or deleted. Rollback of the migration is listed in its header (card_fee rows must be reclassified first). The checkout fields fall back to the previous insert when the columns are missing, and log an issue when the database rejects them.

access.deniedBehavior: Signed-in non-admins and guests see the access notice and load nothing; ledger tables are admin-only under RLS with no client write grant; every ledger RPC calls require_admin_guard first; helpers are not executable by clients. Replayed on Postgres: fan and anon are denied on every RPC and direct write, and RLS returns zero rows to a fan.

evidence.result: 7 suites, 108 tests passed, 0 failed on Node 24.21.0 locally; no hosted database, browser or device.
72 of 72 checks passed on PGlite 0.5.9 (Postgres 18.6); the migration is not applied to staging or development.

features.title: Engineering Support, security review, audit and recovery workspace

source.description: Restricted support signal/review/audit/release RPC with bounded validated snapshots. Existing telemetry and user feedback retain their owning desks and link from Support. Missing/read errors stay unknown; actor/time come from server. No raw credential/payment/user payloads in detection logs. DATA_GOVERNANCE reviews new sources and generated ownership metadata.

actions: Review issues with rationale and occurrence scope; finance/security dispositions need a distinct second reviewer. Register local recovery manifest metadata with authenticated actor/time; follow actual code owner and security/recovery handoffs.

metrics: Bounded issue classifications, confidence and duplicate evidence; dynamic team/source ownership diagram with text alternative; append-only actor/time change history and recovery manifest integrity/compatibility. Missing telemetry/audit/security sources never read as zero or healthy; existing Health/Books/feedback analyses remain linked.

disable.strategy: No money/access/publish/destructive auto-repair. Read recovery is capped; render failures contain the affected feature. Missing support SQL is explicit unavailable and capture fails without changing auth/payment outcomes. Recovery packages restore into new isolated previews only, never execute old SQL or replace live code. Incident records and audit changes are appended, never erased.

access.deniedBehavior: Guest/non-admin reads/writes denied by authenticated role guard and restricted RPC/RLS. Client cannot forge trusted security origin, actor or timestamp. Security/finance review needs independent second actor. Backend replay proves negative access locally; hosted SQL remains unapplied.

evidence.command: pnpm --filter @tapuai/mobile exec jest --watchman=false supportAdapter teamFlow useEngineeringSupport engineeringSupport SupportSignalManager FeatureBoundary session supportCapture

features.title: Profile privacy: public/private, per-item audiences, two-way friends, blocking, hide from search, tag approval

source.description: Canonical sources: profiles (account_private, profile_audience per item, hide_from_search, tag_review, friend_requests_from), friendships (two-way requests), user_blocks; enforced in SQL. Direct reads of other users' profiles rows are closed; other people's profiles come only through profiles_public and definer RPCs that apply the viewer relationship (self, admin, guardian of record, friend, blocked, stranger, guest). A missing migration reads as 'not switched on'; a failed read never shows hidden fields. Design: docs/engineering/design/PROFILE_PRIVACY_DESIGN.md.

actions: Read a person's privacy settings, friend count and block counts (never who)
Reset a person to private defaults
Hide a person from search

metrics: Private vs public accounts, friend requests and blocks in the last 7 UTC days; a failed read shows unknown, never zero

disable.strategy: Feature switch privacy.friends turns new friend requests off without touching existing settings, friendships or blocks; privacy settings and blocks always stay enforced (they protect people). Admin can reset a person to private defaults.

access.deniedBehavior: Only the owner changes their settings (teen rules from MINOR-01 apply in set_my_privacy); admins read and repair. The guardian lock was removed before anything was applied (owner 2026-10-14; MINOR-01 supervision replaces it). Strangers, blocked users and guests get only the always-visible fields (name, username, badges, sport, approved-tagged Highlights, Donate). Enforced by RLS and definer RPCs; wrong-actor tests in scripts/replay/schema-replay.mjs.

features.title: Minor accounts: birth month and year, teen-safe defaults, guardian link and signed consent, supervision and under-16 approvals, under-13 closure

source.description: Canonical sources: profiles (birth_year, birth_month, age_blocked_at, age_check_required), guardian_links, guardian_invites, guardian_invite_attempts, guardian_consents (append-only), guardian_approval_requests, supervision_events; every rule in SQL (definer RPCs, no client table access, a restrictive Closed accounts policy on every RLS table). A missing migration reads as not switched on; the old 13+ checkbox stays there. Design: docs/engineering/design/MINOR_ACCOUNTS_DESIGN.md.

actions: Read a person's age band, birth month and year, closed state, guardian links (names), consent records and supervision summary
Correct a birth month and year with a reason
End a guardian link with a reason
Apply the retention schedule

metrics: Accounts by age band, teens with a guardian, each consent permission, requests waiting for guardians, codes in 7 days, guardians with more than 3 teens, adult friend requests to teens in 7 days, under-13 accounts waiting for deletion; a failed read shows the error, never zero

disable.strategy: Published switch minors.guardian_links = false pauses new guardian codes and links; existing links, consent and the teen rules stay enforced (turning it off never loosens anything). Admin repairs: correct a birth month (with a reason), end a link (with a reason).

access.deniedBehavior: Teens change their own settings (public needs a guardian's consent; under-16 public and open requests go to the guardian to approve). A code-linked guardian, once the teen confirms, sees only the shared supervision summary (counts, never who) and decides approvals; they cannot change settings. Only the guardian on record can allow payouts. Admins read and repair. One refusal message for every account; a closed under-13 account is refused by every table. Wrong-actor tests in scripts/replay/schema-replay.mjs.

evidence.result: 100/100 on PGlite (Postgres 18.6), including 20 MINOR-01 checks; no hosted database.

features.title: Payee verification: SSN to Stripe only, guardian proof (Stripe + school, two admins), payout gate on the actual payee, two-admin payout override

source.description: Canonical sources: payee_verifications (append-only; never an SSN; looks_like_ssn CHECKs) and payout_flag_overrides; athlete_payout_status reads payee_missing_checks for the account that would be paid. Stripe collects SSN / tax ID in its hosted onboarding; record_stripe_kyc (server only) records yes/no results. A missing migration reads as not switched on. Plan: docs/engineering/design/PAYEE_VERIFICATION_PLAN.md.

actions: Read a person's payee picture: athletes, what is missing, check history, overrides
Record a school parent confirmation or document review (never about yourself)
Confirm another admin's relationship check
Revoke a check with a reason
Request or decide a payout override (independent second admin)

metrics: Payees verified by Stripe, parents confirmed, checks waiting for a second admin, Stripe needing more, failed checks in 30 days, overrides waiting; a failed read shows the error, never zero

disable.strategy: No switch loosens these checks (they protect money); payouts stay blocked (503) until the Wave 1 payout path. Repairs: revoke a wrong check (reason), two-admin override of the transfers flag (reason, independent second admin).

access.deniedBehavior: No client reads or writes the records; only the server records Stripe results; an admin never records a check about themselves; relationship checks count only after an independent second admin confirms; the override's requester, subject and the athlete's guardian cannot decide it. Wrong-actor tests in scripts/replay/schema-replay.mjs.

evidence.result: 111/111 on PGlite (Postgres 18.6), including 11 VERIFY-02 checks; no hosted database or Stripe.
